about: Pet Shelf queue. Booked automatically the evening before by pet_shelf_queue.py. Boss rule 11 Nov 2026: previews go to boss; no reply by 08:00 = posts go out. Stop a post: status hold.

posts.caption:
Does your big dog bend low to eat?
This stand lifts the bowls up, and you can set the height.
It is made for medium and large dogs.

posts.brief: Folding wooden dog ramp for beds and couches.
posts.caption:
Is it hard for your dog to jump onto the bed or couch?
This folding ramp gives them a gentle way up.
Check your furniture height first.

posts.brief: Leash-clip poop bag and treat holder.
posts.caption:
Hands full on every walk?
This little pouch clips to the lead and holds bags and treats.
It is small, so it is for the basics only.

Does your indoor cat want to explore outside?
This snug harness and leash let you take short walks together.
Always stay with your cat, and stop if they panic.
